dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: #Hmm? Is that you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon? Ah, wonderful, excellent timing! I was just about to head to the Adventurers' Guild to post a commission!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, well, well! A commission, coming right to us? Guess we're eating good tonight, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, that's right. As famed adventurers, we've got some standards when it comes to our fees...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Don't you worry about that! As long as you manage the various experimental modules as you did before, you'll be well compensated — I guarantee it!

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: *sigh* Have you forgotten me again? It's me, Hosseini, a researcher from Sumeru. We've worked together a bunch of times already, you know...?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I hope you recall the Energy Amplifier, at least?

choices.text: Wait, you're Amplifier Man, aren't you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Oh, right! It's you! You're the one from The Chasm!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're a lot more cheerful than when we saw you last... No wonder we didn't recognize you.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Hehe, is that so? I guess I'm just that happy, then — I haven't been this lucky in a long while.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. What happened? C'mon, tell us!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Well, it's a long story. After we parted last time, I returned straight to the Akademiya and proposed the idea of an artificial Energy Amplifier based on the data we collected.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: At first, my mentor seemed very excited by the proposal. Gave it the "highest praise" right on the spot, in fact. And then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then...?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: He booted me out of Sumeru to make me run errands for him in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what? Why? Didn't he praise you?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Oh, he did praise me! For having the gall to submit a fantasy novel as a project proposal, I mean.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Err, no matter how you spin it, that's definitely not praise...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Indeed. I, too, found myself trapped in a pit of despair for some time. However, I had the good fortune of encountering some fine partners and investors here — they took up my project immediately.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: With their assistance, I've successfully integrated my previous research with Fontainian techniques to create an artificial Energy Amplifier — the "Hosseini Amplifier."

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: As long as it passes the tests as my calculations predict it should, forget the trials of the God of Wisdom — I may yet even become a Sage.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Haven't even graduated yet, have we?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Ahem! No need to fuss over meaningless confounding variables like that. That's just a tiny twist on the road to success.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: The most important thing now is to experimentally verify the actual performance of my Amplifier. That's why I need volunteers to test it within Domains.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: #Well, then, {NICKNAME}, would you like to volunteer to test my Hosseini Amplifier?

choices.text: Simply put, you need me to use it while I beat up baddies.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Yes, precisely. I have nothing but faith in your capabilities, but the current Amplifier design isn't quite up to mark, so do be careful.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: #Now, {NICKNAME}, I have nothing but faith in your capabilities, but the current Amplifier design isn't quite up to mark, so do be careful.

choices.text: Nothing comes to mind there either...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: What about "Amplifier Man," then? Surely that rings a bell!
